title: Lalaine: Measuring and Characterizing Non-Compliance of Apple Privacy Labels at Scale
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring and characterizing non-compliance of Apple privacy labels with Apple's defined requirements and guidelines. While privacy has ethical implications, the paper's core subject matter is technical compliance with specific rules and disclosures, not the evaluation or benchmarking of broader ethical, moral, or religious frameworks. It does not contain a dedicated section for ethical considerations beyond its technical scope.
